verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia (part of the Kong product family) explicitly documents pre-request scripts to run logic before a request is sent, and request chaining that lets you extract values from responses and share state across requests — directly matching the described scripting/chaining/data-massaging workflow, further supported by environments for variable management and CLI automation for CI use. Missing for 10: explicit doc terminology for a distinct 'post-response script' hook (only inferred via chaining/extraction) and independent hands-on corroboration of scripting behavior.
